item.title: Enjoy wine & words with Perry Family on Feb. 26 at the Manteca museum
item.description: The Manteca Historical Museum is conducting an event plus a fundraiser in February.

item.title: Undefeated Lathrop blows past Grace Davis in second half
item.description: Grace Davis came into Greg Leland Gymnasium on Thursday night and went toe-to-toe with undefeated Lathrop, which pulled away in the second half for a 55-31 Western Athletic Conference win.

item.title: Lancers ward off Sierra ahead of 1st-place battle
item.description: East Union isn’t chasing style points. At this point in the season, the Lancers are more concerned with stacking up wins any way they can to keep their lead in the Valley Oak League with a much-anticipated rematch against Central Catholic looming. On Thursday, they slugged it out with visiting Sierra and prevailed in the defensive battle, 38-26.

item.title: UC, CSU ‘business’ success is more important than educating as many Californians as possible
item.description: California is all about opportunity. And that, we are told, includes higher education. That said, unless you are poor enough to have your tuition covered or rich enough to pay for it, the 23-campus California State University system can be pricey and the 9-campus University of California system can you leave one drowning in debt.

item.title: MANTECA SEEKS RE-OPENING OF AUSTIN OFF RAMP SOONER
item.description: Manteca is pushing for the reopening of the southbound offramp on Highway 99 at the Austin Road interchange by year’s end.

item.title: Congressman Harder inspects ICE field office in Stockton
item.description: Congressman Josh Harder entered the fray over the conduct of the Immigration and Customs Enforcement on Thursday as he led an oversight investigation Thursday of the ICE field office in Stockton.

item.title: More work planned for Manteca, EU campuses
item.description: The next phase of Measure A school bond work at East Union High will include a new small gym and the creation of an “athletic entrance” to the campus that first opened in 1966. m

item.title: Q sales tax likely to raise $2M to $3M more than estimate
item.description: Measure Q sales tax is now projected to generate between $14 million and $15 million. It translates into $2 million to $3 million more than budgeted.

item.title: Black History Month celebration Feb. 10 at the senior center
item.description: Manteca is observing Black History Month on Tuesday, Feb. 10, from 4 to 7 p.m. It takes place at the Manteca Senior Center, 295 Cherry Lane.

item.title: $5.4M sewer invoice for Lathrop based on depreciation costs back to 2016
item.description: The appropriateness of the City of Manteca retroactively invoicing the City of Lathrop for $5.4 million in what is basically wastewater treatment plant depreciation charges is being questioned by Lathrop municipal leadership.
